endorsements.label: Slight of Mind: Magic and Social Engineering
endorsements.description: Magicians are the ultimate social engineers; they take something completely untrue and make it believable to an audience sometimes numbering in the millions. In a presentation befitting the Vegas audience, three security professionals who study magic and social engineering will present a combination of entertainment and lecture that will teach the audience some of the themes of stage magic that can be applied to social engineering engagements.
